description: This file defines React components for a dialog/modal UI, including Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTrigger, and DialogClose, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling.

methods.name: Dialog
methods.description: Main component that renders a dialog root using Radix UI's DialogPrimitive.Root.

methods.name: DialogContent
methods.description: Component that renders the content of the dialog, supporting different types ('creation' or 'confirmation') and optional overflow handling.

methods.name: DialogHeader
methods.description: Component that renders the dialog's header with title and optional subtitle.

methods.name: DialogFooter
methods.description: Component that renders the footer area of the dialog with optional divider.

methods.name: DialogTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers opening the dialog, forwarding refs.

methods.name: DialogClose
methods.description: Component that renders a button to close the dialog, with support for different button colors and localized 'close' text.
